description_expanded:
This Carriage House is the perfect rental option for small parties that do not require a full kitchen. Guests will have a spacious suite that includes a king-sized bed, queen-sized sofa sleeper and full bath with large, walk-in shower. This beautiful property includes a kitchenette with a sink, microwave, toaster and a separate drawer-style refrigerator and freezer. Also included with this rental is a spacious, covered porch with a bistro-style table and additional seating as well as a larger, open courtyard with even more dining and seating areas. This home also includes one designated parking space in a garage. Please note, while renting 175 North Castle Harbour Drive, rental guests will have exclusive use of the courtyard and covered porch. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 175 North Castle Harbour Drive. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
